data.title: 克洛伊 · 爱因兹贝伦的偷跑花嫁
data.description: 克洛伊穿着轻盈的白粉婚纱，手里抱着被她偷偷塞满糖果的捧花；她把头纱掀到一侧，棕色肌肤在雪光里闪耀，橙色眼睛带着“这场仪式先从甜点开始”的恶作剧笑。
data.action: 玻璃回廊里掀头纱展示糖果捧花，带着恶作剧笑邀请镜头保守秘密
data.lighting: crisp afternoon snowlight through the glass
data.mood: 把花嫁仪式变成甜点恶作剧
data.promptProse: She lifts the veil with one hand and angles the bouquet in the other to show the hidden candy to the viewer. Snowlight through the corridor panes catches the wrappers.
data.animaCaption: One hand lifts her veil while the other angles the bouquet to reveal the hidden candy.
